rules.title: Residential rental property application fee not to exceed $50
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent shall not require an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease residential rental property for dwelling purposes exceeding $50, adjusted annually by CPI.
rules.summary_plain: Landlords in New Jersey cannot charge more than $50 for rental application fees, and this limit increases yearly with inflation.
rules.summary_plain_es: Los propietarios en Nueva Jersey no pueden cobrar más de $50 por las tarifas de solicitud de alquiler, y este límite aumenta anualmente con la inflación.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to residential rental properties except one-family or two-family dwellings and licensees of the NJ Real Estate Commission who are not landlords.
rules.exemptions_text: Does not apply to dwelling units in one-family or two-family dwellings or to licensees of the NJ Real Estate Commission unless they are landlords.

exemption_conditions.note: Licensee of NJ Real Estate Commission not landlord

rules.penalty: Up to $500 for first offense, $750 for second, and $1,000 for subsequent offenses.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
